name: CAMPHOR / MENTHOL / EUCALYPTUS OINTMENT VICK VAPORUB 12 GR 1 PIECE
description: An ointment to help treat colds. It helps decongest the respiratory tract, making breathing easier; it relieves the discomfort that accompanies a cold. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
